# Michael Malakhov (SOWA_DEV)

> Resume and portfolio of Michael Malakhov, Fullstack Developer: project case studies and a blog.
> The resume is available as Markdown and PDF in Russian (ru) and English (en); the page
> language is set by the path prefix (/ru, /en). Blog posts are written in English only.

## Resume (machine-readable)

- [Resume, Markdown, English](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/resume/en.md): best form for LLMs, plain text
- [Resume, Markdown, Russian](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/resume/ru.md): same content in Russian
- [Resume, PDF, English](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/resume/en.pdf): printable version
- [Resume, PDF, Russian](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/resume/ru.pdf): printable version in Russian

## Pages

- [Home, English](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/en): about, skills, projects and contacts
- [Home, Russian](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/ru): same content in Russian

- [Resume page, Russian](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/ru/resume): same in Russian
- [Projects, English](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/en/projects): all case studies

- [Blog, Russian](https://sowa-dev.duckdns.org/ru/blog): same list with a Russian interface
